refinement_1_g8_v51b_standardized_patch_.scope: Gate G8_V51 patch-novelty feature vector & Mahalanobis+kNN whitening in WS93/analyze.py
refinement_1_g8_v51b_standardized_patch_.root_cause: Stage-1 fit_patch_novelty_model_v51 / evaluate_gate_g8_v51 normalized each 17-px patch by its L2 norm prior to keeping top-8 background PCA components, suppressing isolated 10-30 sigma LSF Gaussians.
refinement_1_g8_v51b_standardized_patch_.fix: Feature-wise standardized Z-score + arcsinh(sub/2.5) + whitened 8-PC Mahalanobis/k=7-NN distance with explicit LSF morphology & cohort-rarity guards (_extract_g8_feat_v51b / _fit_g8_v51b / _eval_g8_v51b).

refinement_2_nirspec_v51b_joint_multicom.scope: JWST NIRSpec G395H multi-component molecular continuum & covariance estimator in WS93/analyze.py
refinement_2_nirspec_v51b_joint_multicom.root_cause: Stage-1 _fit_miri_sideband_template evaluated CO (4.67 um) and 13CO (4.78 um) independently per component so each absorption band contaminated the other's continuum sideband.
refinement_2_nirspec_v51b_joint_multicom.fix: Union-excluded multi-component continuum mask + single joint continuum variance solve (_fit_nirspec_template_v51b / _joint_nirspec_confounder_v51b / _scan_nirspec_v51b).
